Kit summary

Spike AttackBasic
Deals 2 stages of DMG each by 8% of Eilat's Max HP to a single enemy, with a 40% chance to reduce their Effect Hit by 50% for 2 turns.
Sanctuary ShieldActiveExclusive Lv.1
Increases all allies' Max HP Cap by 50% for 2 turns, and inflicts [Block Debuff] on them for 1 turn.
Piercing Bones Lv.1Sanctuary Shield: Additionally grants all allies a [Shield] by 30% of Eilat's Max HP for 2 turns.
Spike OverlayPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Eilat gains an additional 52% DMG Reflect.
Piercing Bones Lv.2Eilat has a 50% chance to counterattack when taking Direct DMG and is guaranteed to counterattack if the attacker's HP is below 50%. Can be stacked with the buff [Counterattack].
Furious SmashActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals DMG by 42% of Eilat's Max HP to a single enemy and inflicts [Provoke] for 1 turn. This skill has an additional 30% Leech. Afterward, increases self DMG Reflect by 30% for 2 turns.
Piercing Bones Lv.3Furious Smash: Increases the DMG by 60% to 120% based on the target's lost HP and slays the target directly if the target's HP is below 25% after dealing DMG.
